preseason_hypothesis: Burrow stays healthy and anchors a top-tier passing offense
confirming_evidence: full participation; no injury designations; high passing volume
disconfirming_evidence: injury absence or limitation, the offense's central risk

preseason_hypothesis: Chase is the alpha WR1 with league-leading target upside
confirming_evidence: first-team routes; dominant target share; red-zone looks
disconfirming_evidence: injury to Burrow; consistent bracket coverage caps volume

preseason_hypothesis: Higgins holds a high-end WR2/co-alpha role with red-zone value
confirming_evidence: stable outside snaps; strong target share; red-zone targets
disconfirming_evidence: target share swings hard toward Chase; Burrow injury

preseason_hypothesis: Brown is the clear lead back in both phases
confirming_evidence: first-unit carries; routes and targets; goal-line work
disconfirming_evidence: committee emerges; passing-down role shifts away

preseason_hypothesis: Game script from a rebuilt defense lifts Brown's rushing workload
confirming_evidence: more neutral/ahead scripts; higher carry volume
disconfirming_evidence: defense struggles; pass-heavy catch-up scripts limit carries

preseason_hypothesis: A pass-catching tight end emerges after Noah Fant's departure
confirming_evidence: a tight end earns routes and targets on passing downs
disconfirming_evidence: tight end stays a low-volume blocking role

preseason_hypothesis: Cincinnati concentrates targets on Chase and Higgins above all others
confirming_evidence: the two lead targets by a wide margin
disconfirming_evidence: a third option takes a meaningful share
